name: Poggio la Noce 2025 EVOO, 500ml
tagline: New Harvest 2025! This was an olive a few short weeks ago!
description: It's here... the 2025 Harvest!! We look forward to this oil coming out every fall - it is truly an amazing representation of true Tuscan olive oil. With hints of freshly cut grass, almonds & artichokes, it's not just one of our favorite oils, it happens to be produced by a couple of our favorite people - husband and wife team, Enzo Schiano and Claire Beliard. The olives from their 1,500 tree grove are hand-picked and pressed on the estate the same day. This helps to preserve all the intense flavor and fragrance of the olives and ensures the lowest grade of acidity possible. This oil was in it's olive state just a few short weeks ago, and in a few more short weeks, it will be gone...get it while you can, when it's gone, it's gone!

name: Spedalotto Tonda Iblea Olio Novello 1025, 500ml
tagline: This oil was an olive a mere 3 weeks ago!
description: Made with the famous Tonda Iblea olives of the Monti Iblei region in Sicily. This amazing oil has green, ripe flavors that are in perfect balance. It is soft with a fresh, green tomato aroma and fruity flavor, like a perfectly ripe late summer heirloom tomato. A delightful complexity is extracted from this single varietal olive, a result of the craftsmanship that goes into the cultivation of rich soil. Spedalotto Tonda Iblea’s approachable flavor profile is easy to love!
